scope: Fresh Base first2 SW updates,64 real on-policy training trajectories; not final100-update model or a downstream effectiveness test

signal_summary.scope: Real on-policy two-update training signals, not full100-update downstream efficacy. Float32 diagnostic reductions of original-dtype components. Instrumentation overhead included.
signal_summary.forward_timer_scope: Outer PEFT forward CUDA events only; excludes rollout, KL, backward, optimizer and saving. Instrumented probe, not formal-run throughput.

interpretation_limits: Global scalar divergence reduction is not the fraction of useful gradient removed.
Teacher/student local argmax agreement is not math correctness or teacher capability.
Mean teacher-minus-student sampled logprob on student rollouts is not a teacher accuracy score.
Early64 trajectories do not establish the cause of final-model regressions; official loss was not replaced.
Chunked detached statistics and CUDA timers add overhead; this is not a production-throughput benchmark.
